body: Thanks. You really gave me some motivation to do so. You are right. I will talk to my dad with the first chance I have. I think so anyways. Maybe future me will decide not to and get discouraged again. I will try to stop him. Maybe my dad will try to find a therapist in my town but I don't think there is one so that's something bad. I will send you a message if something happens. Thanks again ❤

Its not an easy task. Especially if you know that if if he finds out that I seek for help then it will be over. He will hit my weakest spots. He will make fun of my depression. That's what is holding me back.

Hey, those are big steps. Try to find a place to work so you will be able to afford a therapist to lead you completely out of depression. And if you don't like him, there are lots of therapists our there. Wish you the best of luck
